decided: A size sensor lets a project set a maximum number of bytes for files it chooses, and fires when a change makes such a file larger than its maximum and larger than it was when building began. orbit's own generated skills are not stored in the project, so orbit-spec holds them under a recorded maximum, set to today's sizes, with a test instead.
alternatives: fire on every file already over its maximum
measure only the generated skills, which other projects do not have
why: Firing on files that were already too big would stop every change that touches one; a sensor other projects can use must read files they keep, and orbit's own skills are produced on each machine, so only a test can measure them.

defines.definition: A check orbit runs over the code, the change and its history that reports whether a run has gone off course.
The moment a change's building begins, after which its plan no longer changes; a sensor compares against the plan and settings as they stood then.
